title: preflightCli Test 4 no longer observes a real all-pass run; 'passResult' is now also a failing preflight on sentinels
severity_rationale: S3: the variable name and the test claim promise a passing run that the rails make impossible; the assertion that matters (no bot-startup markers) still holds.

evidence.note: Both children now started through spawnRailedChild; second run's override key corrected to ETH_WS_URL. Assertions unchanged. The first run is named passResult but runs on sentinels, where every RPC is refused, so it is now also a failing preflight: the test no longer observes a real all-pass run. Reason: D-03. The old pass case depended on the operator's real .env and network, which no test may reach.

sibling_sites_checked: Every entry of rails-test-edits.json is registered individually or merged with its discovery. The diff of test/integration/preflightCli.test.ts was re-read against audit_base_sha.
